title: Generalized pseudo-product structures and finite type distributions via abnormal extremals
summary: We generalize the classical Tanaka result on the finiteness of the Lie algebra of infinitesimal symmetries for non-degenerate pseudo-product structures to the case when the completely integrable distributions defining the pseudo-product structure are no longer concentrated in the degree $-1$. In order to do this, we modify the notion of universal prolongation of graded nilpotent Lie algebras and generalize the original finiteness criterion of Tanaka.
